catalogMeta.label: Rhyme Pairs (open build)
catalogMeta.description: Open build, pre-reader: eight pictures, no print; tap two that rhyme into a pair tray and press done (cat and hat, moon and spoon); some boards ask for a second pair. Several pairs pass. Every board holds a same-first-sound decoy (cat and car), named same_start. Checked in code from the pictures' known rimes. Beta = identification + 0.1.
